name: Smart India Hackathon
when: Nationwide. Registration usually opens Aug to Sep, grand finale around Dec
about: India's biggest government-run hackathon. Solve real problem statements from ministries and industry.
tip: Teams of 6 need at least one female member and a faculty mentor. Your college must nominate your team first.

name: Devfolio Hackathons
when: Rolling. New hackathons are listed every month
about: Popular Indian platform to find and apply to hackathons, with prizes and internship offers.
tip: Create a profile, link your GitHub, then apply to each hackathon separately.

name: MLH Hackathon Season
when: Season runs all year. Check the live calendar
about: Student hackathons around the world with swag, mentors and sponsor prizes. Beginners are welcome.
tip: Pick a digital event if travel is a problem. Many have a beginner track.

name: Devpost Online Hackathons
when: Rolling
about: Hundreds of online hackathons with cash prizes from companies like Google, Microsoft and more.
tip: Read the "Rules" tab carefully. Some contests are limited by country or age.

name: Flipkart GRiD (via Unstop)
when: Usually starts mid-year. Check Unstop
about: Engineering challenge with coding, tech and robotics-style rounds. Winners can get pre-placement interviews.
tip: Register on Unstop with your college email. Practise DSA and aptitude for round 1.

name: Google Summer of Code
when: Applications open around March to April, coding May to Aug
about: Work on a real open source project with a mentor and receive a stipend.
tip: Start contributing to an organisation 2 to 3 months before applications. Write a clear proposal.

name: Women Techmakers Programs
when: Rolling. Check the program page
about: Scholarships, hackathons and mentorship made for women in tech.
tip: Apply early, because scholarship forms often ask for a short essay and a resume.

name: NASA International Space Apps Challenge
when: Held every October. Registration opens a few weeks before
about: A 48-hour global hackathon where you use NASA data. Not only for coders: designers and storytellers help too.
tip: Find your local host city on the site and join as a team of up to 6.

name: Hult Prize
when: Campus rounds in Fall and Winter, finals in Spring
about: Social entrepreneurship competition. Build a startup idea and pitch it for the grand prize.
tip: Form a team of 3 to 4, then register through your campus Hult Prize chapter.

name: Google Developer Groups (GDG)
when: Monthly events in most cities
about: Talks, workshops and study jams near you. Great for networking and finding teammates.
tip: Search for your city chapter, follow it, and RSVP to events on the chapter page.

name: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors
when: Rolling applications
about: Join a global student community. Run workshops, get Azure credits and mentorship.
tip: You need a school email and a short note about the community work you want to do.

name: Meetup.com Tech and Career Groups
when: Weekly, varies by city
about: Find local groups for coding, design, startups, photography, running and more.
tip: Set your location, pick interests, and join a group. Introduce yourself in the comments.

name: Tata Mumbai Marathon
when: Held every January. Registration opens in the months before
about: One of India's biggest running events with a full marathon, half marathon, 10K and Dream Run.
tip: Full and half marathon usually need 18+. Shorter runs allow younger participants. Check your category.

name: City Runs and Cyclothons
when: Almost every weekend in big cities
about: 5K, 10K and cyclothon events in your city. A good first step before a half marathon.
tip: Filter by your city, pick a 5K, register online and collect your bib one day before.

name: Khelo India University Games
when: Annual, host university changes
about: National multi-sport event for university athletes with medals and cash awards.
tip: You must be nominated by your university. Contact your sports officer early.

name: AIU Inter-University Tournaments
when: Through the academic year
about: Zonal and national inter-university championships in dozens of sports.
tip: Join your college team trials. Selection goes through the university sports board.

name: Mood Indigo, IIT Bombay
when: Usually December
fee: Free entry for many events; some are paid
about: Asia's largest college cultural fest. Competitions, concerts, workshops and more.
tip: Register online for competitions. Entry and accommodation passes are sold separately.

name: Techfest, IIT Bombay
when: Usually December
about: One of Asia's largest science and technology festivals with robotics, coding and lectures.
tip: Teams register on the website for each competition. Check for the accommodation form too.

name: BITS Pilani APOGEE and OASIS
when: Apogee in spring, Oasis in autumn
about: Technical and cultural fests from BITS Pilani, with competitions and workshops.
tip: Buy a pass, then choose your events. Hostel stay needs a separate request.

name: Khelo India Athlete Scholarship
when: Athletes are picked from national events. Check the portal for dates
about: Top athletes can get about ₹6.28 lakh a year for training, coaching, kit, food and a monthly allowance.
tip: You are picked through results at national games, Khelo India Youth Games or University Games. Keep your medals and certificates ready.
how: Play and win medals at district, state, university or national events. | Open the Khelo India website and read the athlete scholarship page. | Your name is picked from the winners list by SAI and the sports federations. | Fill your athlete profile and bank details if the portal asks. | Join the assigned academy and keep your attendance and fitness tests up.

name: Playo: find games near you
when: Every day. Search by sport and city
about: Join local games of badminton, football, cricket, tennis and more. Good for practice and new friends.
tip: Check the venue price and rating before you book. Go with a friend the first time.
how: Install the app or open the website and set your city. | Pick a sport and a time that suits you. | Join an open game or book a court. | Reach 10 minutes early and carry water and sports shoes.

name: Hudle: book courts and turfs
when: Every day
about: Book sports courts, turfs and academies near you and find players to join your game.
tip: Share the slot cost with your team to keep it cheap. Weekday mornings are usually cheaper.
how: Open the website or app and choose your city. | Search the sport and compare venues by price and rating. | Book a slot and invite your friends. | Pay the share and show the booking at the venue.

name: Fit India Movement
when: Rolling. Challenges and quizzes through the year
about: National fitness campaign with challenges, quizzes and events open to students.
tip: Register yourself on the portal and join an active challenge.
how: Open the Fit India website. | Register with your name and mobile or email. | Choose a challenge or event and follow the rules. | Share your progress to earn recognition.

name: Agniveer: Indian Army
how: Register on the Join Indian Army website. | Apply online for your trade when the rally notice is out. | Pass the online Common Entrance Exam. | Clear the physical fitness and measurement tests, then the medical test. | Selected candidates join as Agniveer. Some are kept on after 4 years.
roles: General Duty (10th pass), Technical and Clerk (12th pass), Tradesmen

name: Agniveer: Indian Navy (SSR and MR)
how: Open the Join Indian Navy website and create an account. | Apply for SSR or MR when the notice is out. | Appear in the written exam, then the physical test. | Clear the medical test and wait for the merit list.
roles: SSR needs 12th with Maths and Physics. MR needs 10th pass

name: Agniveervayu: Indian Air Force
how: Open the Agniveervayu portal and register. | Fill the online form and pay the fee if asked. | Appear in the online test. | Clear the physical fitness test, adaptability test and medical test.
roles: Science trades need 12th with Maths, Physics and English. Other trades have their own rules

name: NDA: National Defence Academy
org: UPSC (for Army, Navy and Air Force officers)
how: Watch the UPSC website for the NDA and NAC notice (twice a year). | Apply online on the UPSC portal. | Appear in the written exam (Maths and General Ability). | Clear the SSB interview and medical test. | Join the academy if you are in the final merit list.
pay: Stipend in training, then officer pay
roles: Officer training after 12th. Air Force and Navy wings need Physics and Maths

name: CDS: Combined Defence Services
how: Watch the UPSC website for the CDS notice (twice a year). | Apply online. | Appear in the written exam. | Clear the SSB interview and the medical test. | Join the training academy.
pay: Stipend in training, then officer pay

name: AFCAT: Air Force Officer Entry
how: Open the AFCAT website and register (twice a year). | Fill the form and pay the fee. | Appear in the online AFCAT exam. | Clear the AFSB interview and the medical test. | Join the Air Force Academy.
roles: Flying and Ground Duty (technical and non-technical)

name: Income Tax Inspector (SSC CGL)
how: Create your one-time registration on the SSC website. | Apply for CGL when the notice is out (once a year). | Appear in the Tier 1 and Tier 2 computer-based exams. | Go through document verification. | Choose your posts in order of preference after the result.
roles: Inspector of Income Tax and other group B posts

name: SSC GD Constable (CAPF)
how: Create your one-time registration on the SSC website. | Apply when the GD Constable notice is out. | Appear in the computer-based exam. | Clear the physical efficiency and physical standard tests. | Pass the medical test and document check.
roles: Constable in BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP, SSB and Assam Rifles

name: Delhi Police Constable (Executive)
how: Create your one-time registration on the SSC website. | Apply when the Delhi Police notice is out. | Appear in the computer-based exam. | Clear the physical standard test and the endurance test. | Pass the medical test.

name: Haryana Police Constable
how: Register on the HSSC website with your details. | Apply when the constable notice is out. | Appear in the written exam. | Clear the physical measurement and physical standard tests. | Pass the medical test and document check.

name: CAPF Assistant Commandant
how: Watch the UPSC website for the CAPF (AC) notice (once a year). | Apply online. | Appear in the written exam and essay paper. | Clear the physical standards and medical test. | Appear in the interview.
roles: Group A officer in the central armed police forces

name: UPSC Civil Services (IAS, IPS, IRS)
how: Watch the UPSC website for the notice (once a year). | Apply online and pay the fee. | Appear in Prelims, then Mains. | Appear in the personality test (interview). | Choose your services as per your rank.
pay: Pay as per service and level
roles: IAS, IPS, IRS and other central services
